data.title: 芙莉莲 · 现代咖啡馆
data.description: 【芙莉莲 · 现代咖啡馆】繁华都市的露天咖啡座上，换上现代便服的芙莉莲正手托香腮，好奇地打量着眼前的拿铁咖啡拉花，神情宛如发现新奇魔法的孩子——「只要用牛奶和奶泡，就能在杯子里画出猫咪的图案吗？现代人类发明出来的东西……意外地很有意思呢。」
data.lighting: 露天咖啡座的柔和日光
data.promptProse: At an imagined modern-city cafe, Frieren studies the cat-shaped foam on her latte as intently as a new spell, cheek in one palm and free hand resting on the table. Her soft casual dress and silver-white twintails move in the terrace breeze. The medium view includes cup and saucer before a receding street. Reflected daylight brightens her curious green eyes and foam, leaving the saucer's contact shadow visible.
